## What this is

**CampusZen** — an X/Twitter-style, student-focused social network (India-first), currently at "MVP complete + V1 features shipped". Two independent apps in one repo, no root workspace:

- [frontend/](frontend) — Next.js 16.3.6 App Router, React 19, plain JavaScript/JSX, Tailwind v4, TanStack Query, Biome. Port 3000.
- [backend/](backend) — Express 4 (ESM), Mongoose 8/MongoDB, Zod, JWT+bcrypt, Appwrite for media, Resend/SMTP for OTP mail, Web Push. Port 4000.

Browser → Next.js → `fetch(credentials: "include")` → Express → MongoDB. The frontend never touches Mongo; every read/write is an API call.

## Backend anatomy

Requests flow through a strict, consistent pipeline: [app.js](backend/src/app.js) (helmet with a `'none'` CSP since it's a JSON API, CORS locked to `FRONTEND_URL`, hpp, mongo-sanitize, 10kb JSON cap except 1MB for articles) → route (`validate(zodSchema, source)` + per-route rate limiter + `protect`/`optionalAuth`) → thin controller wrapped in `asyncHandler` → service → Mongoose.

- 20 models, 16 services, 12 route/controller groups. Business logic lives in `services/`; controllers are pass-through. Errors are always `AppError` → `{ success: false, message, code, details }`.
- **Counters are denormalized** (`User.postCount/followersCount`, `Post.likeCount/replyCount/...`) and duplicate prevention relies on partial unique indexes (Like/Follow/Repost).
- **Caching** is a per-process in-memory TTL map with glob invalidation ([cache.js](backend/src/utils/cache.js)). Invalidation is manual and scattered across services (`cache.delPattern("feed:*")` after writes).
- **Feeds**: the "For you"/discovery feed is a seeded deterministic shuffle — post IDs ranked by `hash(seed + id)`, memoized ~10 min, paginated with an opaque base64url cursor carrying `{seed, start, lastId}` ([feedOrder.js](backend/src/utils/feedOrder.js)). The following feed is a straightforward `createdAt` keyset cursor.
- **Realtime** is SSE at `/api/events` (notifications, unread counts, post/follow updates) plus Web Push/VAPID for closed-app delivery.

## Auth & account state

Dual-token JWT in HTTP-only cookies: 15m access, refresh rotation backed by a per-device [Session](backend/src/models/Session.js) document (`prevTokenHash` grace window so two tabs don't look like theft). OTP verification is mandatory before any session is usable. [middleware/auth.js](backend/src/middleware/auth.js) encodes a layered gate: banned → no session at all; suspended → read-only session for the standing page; **restricted → read-only with an explicit allowlist of write paths** (`RESTRICTED_WRITE_ALLOW`), auto-lifted lazily on request and by a 5-minute sweep in [server.js](backend/src/server.js); unverified email → 403 before anything else. Admin is entirely env-gated (`ADMIN_EMAIL`/`ADMIN_PASSKEY`) with its own cookie and `/api/admin/*`.

## Frontend anatomy

Route groups: landing `/`, `(auth)/*`, authenticated shell `/app/*`, public `/u/[username]`, colleges `/c/*`, env-gated `/admin`, plus marketing/docs/legal routes. [AppShell.jsx](frontend/components/app/AppShell.jsx) is the single three-column frame; it owns the session gate, the SSE subscription, and the suspended/restricted banners.

Two rules I'll respect:
1. [lib/api.js](frontend/lib/api.js) is the only place that talks to Express — 118 methods, single-flight 401 refresh, an explicit `NO_AUTO_RETRY` list, and `status: 0 / offline: true` for transport failures.
2. Server state goes through [lib/hooks/queries.js](frontend/lib/hooks/queries.js) with centrally declared `queryKeys`; no ad-hoc fetches in components.

Design comes from [DESIGN.md](DESIGN.md) and tokens in [globals.css](frontend/app/globals.css): near-black `#0f1419`, single accent `#1d9bf0`, hairline borders instead of shadows, pill radii, `--cz-*` variables, light/dark driven by the `cz-theme` cookie read in the root layout. [next.config.mjs](frontend/next.config.mjs) enforces a real CSP and cache headers.

The last four commits (through Oct 28) are all gamification: a 9-tier bronze/silver/gold achievement ladder ([utils/achievements.js](backend/src/utils/achievements.js)), denormalized `User.achievementTier`, quality-follower filtering (only followers active in 30 days count), and a UTC-day posting streak with a 6-hour anti-gaming cooldown ([userService.updateStreak](backend/src/services/userService.js#L577)).
